searchText: i guess we've got a lot of these scenarios... like invalid indexes in attester duties as a general rule i like the theory of returning the key requested with the empty result, so that the round trip is more symmetrical makes it easier to reconcile that the request was received and there was nothing to report i do have to admit i did swallow invalid indexes in preference to returning an invalid key though for attester duties
